source_note: The course as people watch it (spec §6.9): free material, the Introduction, and the three phases. Steps and their parts are NOT repeated here — they come from the step content, so a part is named in one place. This file holds only what the content cannot know: the free items, the Introduction, and which workbook belongs to which step.

items.title: The Ordinary Tuesday
items.blurb: About 20 minutes, 3 pages to print or fill in on screen. Not a holiday: one normal Tuesday in the life you want, in enough detail to test it. It works wherever that life is, including right where you are now.
